pages.title: A Naturalist’s Cabinet
pages.text: A specialized potion prepares you for a particular natural threat.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A rattlesnake rattle turns Poison into Poisonous Essence; a centipede leg leads to resistance. Cockroach wings give pheromones. A Soul Vulture heart relates to health theft. Lava Vision and Clinging are in the adjacent route.
